back: A legal agreement between employer and employee setting out the terms and conditions of the job.
Job title and duties, start date, place, hours, pay, leave, notice period, disciplinary and grievance procedures, benefits.

front: Benefits of a contract to the employer?
back: Clear duties and hours, fewer disputes, notice period to replace leavers.
Ending a contract without a fair reason or without following a fair procedure.
Treating a person less favourably because of gender, race, religion, age, disability or similar.

front: Effects of health and safety laws on employers?
back: Costs of equipment, training and inspections; fewer accidents, lost days and claims; better motivation.

front: Effects of a higher minimum wage on employers?
back: Higher wage costs: higher prices, lower profit, fewer workers or more machines; possibly better motivation.
Dismissal: because of the employee's conduct or ability. Redundancy: the job is no longer needed.
